title.value: Auditing Data Controller Compliance with Data Withdrawal

abstract.value: We study auditing total data withdrawal, the case in which a user requests the exclusion of their data from both the training and test data for some machine learning task. This approach is motivated by the need for comprehensive compliance with data privacy regulations and legal frameworks around the world. We conceptualize the task of auditing total data withdrawal as an optimization problem. Compliance verification is conducted under mild assumptions using a dedicated verification algorithm. We then evaluate this formulation over various datasets, architectures, and verification hyperparameters. Our verification algorithm serves as a tool for regulators to ensure auditable compliance and provides enhanced privacy guarantees for users.

primary_area.value: alignment, fairness, safety, privacy, and societal considerations
